name: southbag-online-banking
description: A ***deliberately terrible*** 'online banking' website made for Borked, a bad site jam as a satirical version of my banks online banking system. I dont like it that much.

scripts.test: node --import ./tests/register-stubs.mjs --test tests/mcp.test.js tests/sdk-compat.test.js tests/billing-entrypoint.test.js tests/central-freeze.test.js tests/slack-freeze.test.js tests/ai.test.js tests/daily-fee-d1.test.js tests/economy.test.js tests/slack-link.test.js tests/slack-bot.test.js && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.build: node --check worker.js && node --check economy.js && node --check mcp.js && node --check slack-link.js && node --check slack-bot.js && node --check slack-api.js && node --check slack-commands.js && node --check slack-prompt.js && node --check ai.js
